target: Full Port of AI Settings, Permissions, Model Config & A11y Feedback to Clean Architecture Server

backend.description: Extend CLISettings to support full settings.json reads and safe atomic writes for model, effort, safe_mode, trustedWorkspaces, feedback toggles, and permissions.allow mappings.

Add /api/v1/cli/settings GET and PATCH endpoints with atomic ETag/revision support. Ensure /api/v1/settings continues rejecting cli_owned changes to preserve backward compatibility and HTTP test assertions.

adapter.description: Remove artificial cliFields blocking. Bridge /api/ai/settings GET and POST requests cleanly to /api/v1/cli/settings and /api/v1/cli/policy. Implement whitelist add/remove operations.

frontend.description: Remove unsupported disabled flags and explanatory notes. Enable all 5 permission switches (commands, write, web, subagents, schedule) and autopilot switch. Connect whitelist manager and trusted workspaces chip array.
